card.title: How To Repair iPad Air 6 12.9" Touch Not Working

source.title: How To Repair iPad Air 6 12.9" Touch Not Working

claims.statement: iPad Air 6 (13-inch) with no touch and a good image, unfixed by a known-good screen, commonly has a shorted capacitor on a touch rail at the display FPC.
Inject 1–2 V at 1–2 A with rosin to find the cap that heats first, then replace it.

procedure: Inject 1–2 V; find the hot cap; replace from donor.
card.caveats: Rail name is only shown in images on the source page. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
